events.title: Funny Coast Comedy: Dave Thornton & Friends
events.description: A night of stand-up comedy featuring professional comedians Dave Thornton and friends in an intimate theatre setting. Expect observational humor and a lively atmosphere typical of local independent comedy nights.

events.title: Acoustic Guitar Spectacular
events.description: An evening showcasing virtuoso acoustic guitar performances in the historic and atmospheric Majestic Theatre. Ideal for music enthusiasts interested in technical skill and intimate acoustic arrangements.

events.title: Noosa Jazz Festival: Tom Baker Tribute Concert
events.description: A jazz tribute performance dedicated to Tom Baker, hosted in a classic theatre setting. This event draws a community of music lovers interested in traditional jazz and cultural history.
